verdict.rationale: EBANX's marketing page lists 'smart retry logic' as part of its Recurring Payments solution, and recurring Pix is documented for subscription management. That is first-party but thin support for automatically retrying failed subscription payments. Nothing in the pack shows dunning workflows or customer recovery emails, and the notification-retry docs cover webhook delivery, not payment retries. Missing for 10: documented retry configuration and schedules, dunning workflow, recovery/reminder emails to customers, dashboard controls for finance-ops, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails

citations.quote: Recurring Payments solution that includes local currency and alternative payment method acceptance, unified reconciliation, smart retry logic, tokenized credit card payments
Enable recurring Pix payments with automatic debit authorization, reducing churn and simplifying subscription management.
